impact: STRUCTURAL TRAP, whole-repo: there are TWO compute twins, and a feat effect wired into the wrong one passes every test while the player's sheet never changes. src/rules_core/pilot_compute.rs references 34 distinct feat_effects:: producers; src/rules_core/pilot_compute_corpus.rs references ZERO. The shipped sheet's AC / touch / flat-footed / CMB / CMD / melee attack bonus and its selected skill totals all come from the CORPUS twin via pf1_adapter::resolve_unified_pilot_snapshot; only saves, ability mods, BAB and the explanation records come from the hardcoded twin. The corpus twin reproduces exactly one feat, Dodge, hand-inlined rather than via feat_effects. Two SD-27 ARG feats were wired into the hardcoded twin, tested green against it, and reported as 'lands on computed AC' / 'lands on computed Climb total'; neither moves anything on a real sheet. Separately: no surface renders a feat's grounded record at all -- the Actions tab is class-features-only, so a feat magnitude that is not folded into a computed total is invisible to a player by construction.
resolution: Not resolved. Deferred with a named fix; see the paired deferral in this same log.
